 Bulldogs face stiff challenge in men's basketball against Musketeers 
 By Danny P. Smith 
 Nov 12, 2026 
 Nov 12, 2026 
 Updated 
 Nov 12, 2026 
 Comments 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 WhatsApp 
 SMS

 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 WhatsApp 
 SMS 
 Email

 There may be “a ton to like” for Mississippi State men’s basketball coach Chris Jans after three games this season.
 He also understands the work must continue.
 The Bulldogs get their biggest test of the season to date when they play Xavier Friday at The Greenbriar Tipoff at White Sulphur Springs, West Virginia.
 On the way to a 3-0 record, MSU has defeated Tennessee Tech 106-88, Northwestern State 82-44 and Jackson State 98-57.
 Jans knows the Bulldogs are far from a finished product but likes the progress.
